commentary: The waterfall is compressing hard: H100 spot has collapsed to $2.28-3.10/hr (down from $7+ in early 2024) while B200 commands only 2.5-3x that floor at $8-10/hr, suggesting rapid commoditization rather than sustained premium capture. Amazon's Jan 2025 reversal to 5-year lives and Microsoft walking from Oracle's 3-year-old H100 deal directly contradict the 6-year depreciation schedules underpinning hyperscaler and CoreWeave earnings—if rental rates keep falling and economic lives prove closer to 3 years than 6, the $35B debt pile trading at 16% yields and 1,240bps CDS correctly prices the mismatch between book assumptions and market reality.
